summary: The corrected clinger enlightenment case reaches C's attributes_enlightenment ceiling-capability line. The JavaScript port evaluates has_ceiling at the matching source line, but insight.js omitted the import, so the C/JS recording stops at step 124.

source.branch: attributes_enlightenment reports ceiling clinging for is_clinger(gy.youmonst.data). It calls has_ceiling(&u.uz), then reports current ability only when a lid exists and the hero is not in water; otherwise it builds the conditional/past-tense message using the same has_lid value.
dependencies: dungeon.c:has_ceiling is already ported as js/dungeon.js:has_ceiling

evidence: Read nethack-c/upstream/src/insight.c:1487-2005, including the complete attributes_enlightenment source function. Its clinger branch at 1739-1752 calls has_ceiling before selecting the current or conditional disclosure text.

Read js/insight.js:1480-2005. The corresponding function calls has_ceiling(u.uz, state) at 1747 but the module's dungeon.js import only binds depth, dunlev, endgamelevelname, surface, and ceiling. js/dungeon.js already exports has_ceiling with the source behavior.

The manifest confirms the actual corrected monster is a clinger and the case reaches the ceiling ability line. Its accepted error-prefix proof matches 124 screens/cursors and 2522 RNG calls through step 123, then stops at step 124 on the missing binding. The production path is doattributes -> enlightenment -> attributes_enlightenment.
After binding the existing js/dungeon.js:has_ceiling export in insight.js, focused scripts/insight.test.mjs passed 80/80 (run-anW4w1) and ESLint passed (run-fcP2nS).
The v72 clinger production range matched screens, cursor positions and RNG through segment 0 step 148 (run-NFZ3wY). The focused test replays the complete 149-step recording.
